# llm-memory-pyramid (NapMem)

> NapMem: a 4-layer multi-granularity memory pyramid for LLM agents. Distills session logs and memory files into deduplicated atomic records, topic tracks and profiles, with provenance back to the raw source, served through tool-driven retrieval and an MCP stdio server.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, pyramid layers, quick start, components
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Architecture paragraph, invariants, conventions
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Architecture
- [docs/COMPONENTS.md](docs/COMPONENTS.md): Component reference
- [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): MCP server tools
- [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md): Security notes
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): Testing
- [docs/known-issues.md](docs/known-issues.md): Known issues

## Key files

- [memory_pyramid_distiller.py](memory_pyramid_distiller.py): Core distiller: extraction, dedup, session reconciliation, layer rebuild
- [naptime_consolidator.py](naptime_consolidator.py): Background watcher that re-ingests changed .md files
- [napmem_retrieval_agent.py](napmem_retrieval_agent.py): Read-only retrieval: search, provenance, topic tracks, stats
- [llm_extractor.py](llm_extractor.py): Production extraction via the Anthropic Batches API
- [ollama_extractor.py](ollama_extractor.py): Local Ollama extraction alternative
- [semantic_index.py](semantic_index.py): Embedding index with Ollama or hashed-TF backend
- [napmem_mcp_server.py](napmem_mcp_server.py): Stdlib MCP stdio server
- [memory_pyramid_schema.json](memory_pyramid_schema.json): JSON Schema for the pyramid store
